category_edits.rationale: Add a 0.1-weighted margin ranking loss using the existing sampled negatives for all four category models. This encourages positive-negative separation while preserving the GRU architecture, sampling, optimizer, schedule, and inference.

edits.replace:
pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)
    margin_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(0.5 + valid_neg - valid_pos).mean()
    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * margin_loss
